/* Support-page vector art.
 *
 * Replaces the raster `public/nx/art/support-hero-banner.webp` (an 1800x600
 * AI render drawn into a ~1150x420 box, so ~1x on a retina screen at best,
 * with its glow, its "REAL PEOPLE. REAL SOLUTIONS." copy and an off-brand "NX"
 * mark baked into pixels that could not follow light mode, and that shrank to
 * an illegible thumbnail on a phone).
 *
 * Everything here is inline SVG reading the theme tokens (`--color-blue`,
 * `--color-violet`, `--color-magenta`, `--color-cyan`, `--color-mint`,
 * `--color-surface`, `--color-well`, `--color-rim-hi`, `--color-tx-*`), so it
 * is crisp at any density and flips with `data-theme="light"` for free.
 *
 * <defs> ids are namespaced by a per-component prefix: two SVGs on one page
 * that both define `id="grad"` silently share whichever was parsed first.
 *
 * Decorative only — every export is `aria-hidden`. Motion is limited to two
 * small loops (typing dots, one packet on the orbit) and stops under
 * prefers-reduced-motion.
 */

const stop = (v: string, o = 1) => ({ stopColor: `var(--color-${v})`, stopOpacity: o });

function ArtStyles() {
  return (
    <style>{`
      .nxs-dot { animation: nxs-dot 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
      .nxs-dot:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay: .18s; }
      .nxs-dot:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay: .36s; }
      @keyframes nxs-dot { 0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: .55; transform: translateY(0); } 30% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-3px); } }
      .nxs-pulse { animation: nxs-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
      @keyframes nxs-pulse { 0% { opacity: .55; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.6); } }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .nxs-dot, .nxs-pulse { animation: none; }
        .nxs-packet { display: none; }
      }
    `}</style>
  );
}

/**
 * The hero composition: an open ticket thread (with the status filament the
 * portal uses for live objects), a brand-gradient chat bubble in front of it,
 * a service-status chip and a help-article card, tied together by one orbit.
 */
export function SupportHeroArt({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  const p = "nxsh";
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 560 380" className={className} aria-hidden focusable="false" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <ArtStyles />
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-brand`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("blue")} />
          <stop offset="55%" style={stop("violet")} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("magenta")} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-orbit`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("cyan", 0)} />
          <stop offset="25%" style={stop("blue", 0.9)} />
          <stop offset="70%" style={stop("violet", 0.9)} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("magenta", 0)} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-panel`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("surface")} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("well")} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-edge`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("blue", 0.75)} />
          <stop offset="50%" style={stop("rim-hi", 0.9)} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("violet", 0.7)} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-filament`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("cyan")} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("blue")} />
        </linearGradient>
        <radialGradient id={`${p}-halo`} cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("violet", 0.32)} />
          <stop offset="55%" style={stop("blue", 0.12)} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("blue", 0)} />
        </radialGradient>
        <filter id={`${p}-soft`} x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="14" />
        </filter>
        <path id={`${p}-orbit-path`} d="M 40 250 C 90 120, 470 80, 525 175 C 570 255, 260 350, 40 250 Z" />
      </defs>

      {/* ground halo */}
      <ellipse cx="290" cy="200" rx="270" ry="175" fill={`url(#${p}-halo)`} />

      {/* orbit — back half */}
      <use href={`#${p}-orbit-path`} fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p}-orbit)`} strokeWidth="1.6" opacity="0.55" />

      {/* ── main thread panel ── */}
      <g transform="translate(150 54)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="300" height="236" rx="18" fill={`url(#${p}-panel)`} stroke={`url(#${p}-edge)`} strokeWidth="1.4" />
        {/* status filament — the "live object" edge */}
        <rect x="0" y="22" width="3.5" height="62" rx="1.75" fill={`url(#${p}-filament)`} />
        {/* header */}
        <circle cx="26" cy="30" r="5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-cyan)" }} />
        <circle cx="26" cy="30" r="5" className="nxs-pulse" style={{ fill: "var(--color-cyan)" }} />
        <rect x="40" y="25" width="118" height="10" rx="5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-mute)" }} opacity="0.75" />
        <rect x="226" y="22" width="56" height="16" rx="8" fill="none" style={{ stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1.2" />
        <rect x="236" y="28" width="36" height="4" rx="2" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-faint)" }} />
        <line x1="18" y1="54" x2="282" y2="54" style={{ stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1" opacity="0.8" />

        {/* staff message */}
        <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="11" fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} />
        <path d="M 26 82 l 3 3 l 6 -6" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        <rect x="50" y="68" width="190" height="52" rx="12" style={{ fill: "var(--color-well)", stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="64" y="81" width="148" height="7" rx="3.5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-mute)" }} opacity="0.7" />
        <rect x="64" y="96" width="104" height="7" rx="3.5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-faint)" }} opacity="0.7" />

        {/* customer message */}
        <rect x="104" y="134" width="160" height="40" rx="12" fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} opacity="0.28" />
        <rect x="104" y="134" width="160" height="40" rx="12" fill="none" style={{ stroke: "var(--color-violet)" }} strokeOpacity="0.5" strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="118" y="147" width="118" height="7" rx="3.5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-body)" }} opacity="0.65" />
        <rect x="118" y="160" width="70" height="5" rx="2.5" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-body)" }} opacity="0.4" />
        <circle cx="280" cy="154" r="10" fill="none" style={{ stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1.4" />

        {/* reply composer */}
        <rect x="18" y="192" width="264" height="28" rx="10" style={{ fill: "var(--color-well)", stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1" />
        <rect x="30" y="203" width="86" height="6" rx="3" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-faint)" }} opacity="0.6" />
        <rect x="240" y="197" width="36" height="18" rx="7" fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} />
        <path d="M 252 206 h 12 m -4 -4 l 4 4 l -4 4" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      </g>

      {/* ── live chat bubble, front-left ── */}
      <g transform="translate(58 196)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="140" height="78" rx="22" fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} filter={`url(#${p}-soft)`} opacity="0.55" />
        <path d="M 22 0 H 118 A 22 22 0 0 1 140 22 V 56 A 22 22 0 0 1 118 78 H 44 L 22 96 L 26 78 H 22 A 22 22 0 0 1 0 56 V 22 A 22 22 0 0 1 22 0 Z"
              fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} />
        <path d="M 22 1.5 H 118 A 20.5 20.5 0 0 1 138.5 22" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeOpacity="0.45" strokeWidth="1.2" />
        <g fill="#fff">
          <circle className="nxs-dot" cx="46" cy="39" r="7" />
          <circle className="nxs-dot" cx="70" cy="39" r="7" />
          <circle className="nxs-dot" cx="94" cy="39" r="7" />
        </g>
      </g>

      {/* ── service-status chip, top-right ── */}
      <g transform="translate(372 30)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="150" height="40" rx="20" fill={`url(#${p}-panel)`} style={{ stroke: "var(--color-rim-hi)" }} strokeWidth="1.2" />
        <circle cx="22" cy="20" r="6" style={{ fill: "var(--color-mint)" }} />
        <circle cx="22" cy="20" r="6" className="nxs-pulse" style={{ fill: "var(--color-mint)" }} />
        {/* uptime ticks */}
        {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => (
          <rect key={i} x={40 + i * 8.4} y={i === 8 ? 16 : 13} width="4.6" height={i === 8 ? 8 : 14} rx="2.3"
                style={{ fill: i === 8 ? "var(--color-amber)" : "var(--color-mint)" }} opacity={i === 8 ? 0.85 : 0.7} />
        ))}
      </g>

      {/* ── help article card, bottom-right ── */}
      <g transform="translate(404 232)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="122" height="96" rx="16" fill={`url(#${p}-panel)`} stroke={`url(#${p}-edge)`} strokeWidth="1.2" />
        <rect x="16" y="16" width="30" height="30" rx="9" fill={`url(#${p}-brand)`} opacity="0.95" />
        {/* open book */}
        <path d="M 22 25 q 4 -2 9 0 v 13 q -5 -2 -9 0 Z M 40 25 q -4 -2 -9 0 v 13 q 5 -2 9 0 Z" fill="none" stroke="#fff" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinejoin="round" />
        <rect x="16" y="58" width="90" height="6" rx="3" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-mute)" }} opacity="0.7" />
        <rect x="16" y="72" width="64" height="6" rx="3" style={{ fill: "var(--color-tx-faint)" }} opacity="0.7" />
      </g>

      {/* orbit — front arc, drawn over the panels */}
      <path d="M 525 175 C 570 255, 260 350, 40 250" fill="none" stroke={`url(#${p}-orbit)`} strokeWidth="2" />
      <circle r="3.5" className="nxs-packet" style={{ fill: "var(--color-cyan)" }}>
        <animateMotion dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite" rotate="auto">
          <mpath href={`#${p}-orbit-path`} />
        </animateMotion>
      </circle>
      {/* sparkles */}
      {[[118, 96, 3], [512, 112, 2.4], [356, 352, 2.6], [70, 160, 2]].map(([x, y, r], i) => (
        <circle key={i} cx={x} cy={y} r={r} style={{ fill: i % 2 ? "var(--color-cyan)" : "var(--color-violet)" }} opacity="0.85" />
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Empty ticket inbox: a resting tray with a single checked card above it. */
export function SupportEmptyArt({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  const p = "nxse";
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 220 150" className={className} aria-hidden focusable="false" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-brand`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">

          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("magenta")} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={`${p}-panel`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("surface")} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("well")} />
        </linearGradient>
        <radialGradient id={`${p}-halo`} cx="50%" cy="55%" r="50%">
          <stop offset="0%" style={stop("violet", 0.28)} />
          <stop offset="100%" style={stop("blue", 0)} />
        </radialGradient>
      </defs>

/* Support-page vector art.
 *
 * Replaces the raster `public/nx/art/support-hero-banner.webp` (an 1800x600
 * AI render drawn into a ~1150x420 box, so ~1x on a retina screen at best,
 * with its glow, its "REAL PEOPLE. REAL SOLUTIONS." copy and an off-brand "NX"
 * mark baked into pixels that could not follow light mode, and that shrank to
 * an illegible thumbnail on a phone).
 *
 * Everything here is inline SVG reading the theme tokens (`--color-blue`,
 * `--color-violet`, `--color-magenta`, `--color-cyan`, `--color-mint`,
 * `--color-surface`, `--color-well`, `--color-rim-hi`, `--color-tx-*`), so it
 * is crisp at any density and flips with `data-theme="light"` for free.
 *
 * <defs> ids are namespaced by a per-component prefix: two SVGs on one page
 * that both define `id="grad"` silently share whichever was parsed first.
 *
 * Decorative only — every export is `aria-hidden`. Motion is limited to two
 * small loops (typing dots, one packet on the orbit) and stops under
 * prefers-reduced-motion.
 */

const stop = (v: string, o = 1) => ({ stopColor: `var(--color-${v})`, stopOpacity: o });

function ArtStyles() {
  return (
    <style>{`
      .nxs-dot { animation: nxs-dot 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
      .nxs-dot:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay: .18s; }
      .nxs-dot:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay: .36s; }
      @keyframes nxs-dot { 0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: .55; transform: translateY(0); } 30% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-3px); } }
      .nxs-pulse { animation: nxs-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
      @keyframes nxs-pulse { 0% { opacity: .55; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.6); } }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .nxs-dot, .nxs-pulse { animation: none; }
        .nxs-packet { display: none; }
      }
    `}</style>
  );
}

**Incident.** Every fresh Minecraft Bedrock deploy failed provisioning with `game port 19132/udp never opened ... ECONNREFUSED`, on every node and plan. The container started, logged `Server started.`

**Root cause.** Since BDS 1.26.50 Mojang's default `transport` in server.properties is `nethernet` (WebRTC: one dual-stack TCP signalling socket on `server-port`, UDP negotiated per client), not `rakn

**Version matrix** (fresh data dir, throwaway VM; "RakNet ping" = unconnected ping to the published UDP port answered with a pong):

| BDS | default transport | with `TRANSPORT=raknet` |
|---|---|---|
| 1.26.45.1 | raknet: UDP 19132/19133 open, ping OK | same, ping OK |
| 1.26.50.5 | nethernet: TCP 19132 only, no UDP, ping fails | UDP open, ping OK (logs a TRANSPORT TYPE ERROR notice) |
| 1.26.51.1 | nethernet, same | UDP open, ping OK (notice) |
| 1.26.52.3 | nethernet, same | UDP open, ping OK (notice) |

## Customer Support page overhaul (2026-10-06, branch feature/support-page-overhaul)

`/dashboard/support` (`app/dashboard/support/page.tsx` → `components/nx/SupportView.tsx`) was rebuilt around "how do I get help fast". All existing functionality is kept: inline ticket threads + `?ticket=` deep links (and the `/dashboard/support/[id]` redirect shim), 3s thread poll + staff-typing poll, reply composer with attachments/paste/dictation, 5-minute message edit, close/reopen, staff DMs (Messages tab), embedded live chat (ChatWidget, unchanged), help center, service status, feedback link.

- **Raster art removed.** The hero used `public/nx/art/support-hero-banner.webp` (1800x600 AI render: drawn ~1x on retina, baked-in "REAL PEOPLE…" text and an off-brand "NX" mark, a black slab in light mode, an illegible thumbnail on phones). It is replaced by inline SVG in `components/nx/visual/SupportArt.tsx` (`SupportHeroArt`, `SupportEmptyArt`, `SupportNoMatchArt`), drawn only from theme tokens so it is crisp at any density and follows light/dark. The staff avatar in the art is the `nlogo` N mark. The old webp/png files are no longer referenced by the page but are left in `public/` (nothing deleted). Help-center categories use vector icons instead of emoji.
- **Hero.** Greeting, honest promise from `lib/support-promise.ts` (`SUPPORT_REPLY_WINDOW`; the old "usually within minutes / real people" chips contradicted it and the AI assistant), inline help-article search (Enter → `/help?q=`), New ticket + Chat buttons, and a metric strip (open, waiting for you, resolved 30d, this customer's measured avg first reply). Four channel cards show real state: assistant online, ticket reply window, `overallStatus()` from `lib/monitoring.ts`, help article count. While a thread is open the hero collapses to one line so the conversation is above the fold.
- **Ticket list.** Rows (not a table) with a status filament on the left edge, filter chips with counts (All / Waiting for you / Open / Closed), search on subject, message or `#ref`. Priority is shown on rows only when High/Urgent. Attachment-only last messages preview as "Sent an attachment: name".
- **New ticket flow** (`NewTicketForm` in `components/customer/TicketForms.tsx`, still backward compatible): category picker, "Which service?" picker (servers, game servers, web hosting, domains the customer owns), priority segmented control with guidance, message via the shared `ReplyComposer` (attachments, paste, dictation), and live "these might answer it" article suggestions. Bottom sheet on phones. It is portalled to `<body>`: rendered in place it sat inside the page card's stacking context and the shell's bottom nav covered its buttons on mobile.
- **No schema change.** `createTicket` (`lib/actions-support.ts`) writes category + service as a two-line header at the top of the opening message (`Category: …` / `Service: …`, then a blank line). Staff see it as plain text everywhere (admin desk, Discord mirror); the customer thread parses it back into chips and the Ticket details rail. Category keys are validated against `TICKET_CATEGORIES`; the service id is re-resolved server-side with a `userId`-scoped query (`resolveOwnedServiceLabel`), and a service that is not the caller's own is refused with an error (no ticket created). Attachments (max 6, 10 MB each) go through `validateTicketAttachmentBytes` BEFORE the ticket is created, then are stored as attachment-only messages behind the opening message (the same shape `replyTicket` uses for multi-file sends).
- **Pure helpers:** `lib/support-intake.ts` (categories, `parseServiceRef`, `composeTicketBody`/`parseTicketBodyHeader`, `suggestArticles`, ticket filters). Tests: `test/support-intake.test.ts`; `createTicket` added to the ownership-proof list in `test/customer-actions-guards.test.ts`.
- **Styles:** page-scoped `app/dashboard/support/support.css` (`nx-sup-*` classes only), kept out of `globals.css` to avoid merge conflicts with the parallel Domains/SSL overhauls.
- Screenshots (before/after, desktop 1440 + mobile 390, light + dark), seed + Playwright scripts: `/root/agent-notes/support-overhaul/`.
EOF
cat > /root/.gitignore-check 2>/dev/null; rm -f /root/.gitignore-check; git add app/dashboard/support/page.tsx app/dashboard/support/support.css components/customer/TicketForms.tsx components/nx/SupportView.tsx components/nx/visual/SupportArt.tsx lib/actions-support.ts lib/support-intake.ts test/support-intake.test.ts test/customer-actions-guards.test.ts docs/DOCUMENTATION.md && git status --short

input.message:
**Support page overhaul is done and committed. Not merged, not deployed.**
- Branch `feature/support-page-overhaul`, worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-support`, commit `253879aded` (one commit on top of main `b23bc8e8d5`).
- Only the 10 changed files were added by explicit path. Nothing was deleted from `public/`, and live chat internals were not touched.
- tsc is clean. `test/support-intake.test.ts` passes 11/11. In `test/customer-actions-guards.test.ts` 22 pass and 1 fails. That failure ("serverAction returns errors…") checks `lib/actions.ts`, which this branch doesn't touch.
- In `test/auth-lockouts.test.ts`, 4 checks fail. The one I traced lists unguarded exports in `lib/actions-admin-client.ts`; I did not compare the other three against main.

**Screenshots:** `/root/agent-notes/support-overhaul/before/` and `/after/`. They cover list, thread, new-ticket form and empty state at desktop 1440 and mobile 390, in light and dark. The after folder also has the help, status and live-chat tabs, a thread showing the new category/service header, and a real ticket created end to end (`e2e-created-ticket-*`, `e2e-created-thread-light.png`). Seed and Playwright scripts are in the same folder.

**Images replaced and why they looked bad:**
- `public/nx/art/support-hero-banner.webp` (1800x600, no transparency) was the main hero picture. It is AI-generated, about 1x on retina screens, and has blurry text ("REAL PEOPLE. REAL SOLUTIONS.") baked into the pixels. It shows a fake "NX" mark that isn't the real logo, sits on a black slab in light mode, and shrinks to an unreadable thumbnail on phones. Its "Real people / usually within minutes" chips also contradicted the shared reply promise in `lib/support-promise.ts` ("one business day") and the fact that live chat is the AI assistant.
- It is replaced by inline SVG in a new shared file, `components/nx/visual/SupportArt.tsx` (`SupportHeroArt`, `SupportEmptyArt`, `SupportNoMatchArt`). It uses only the brand colour tokens, so it is sharp at any size and follows light/dark. The staff avatar in the art is the Nxeon "N" mark from the icon set.
- The help-center category emoji (🎮🖥️…) are now icons from the design-system icon set.
- The raster `chatsupport` sprite icon is no longer used on the page.

**What changed on the page (all existing features kept):**
- **Top of page:** a greeting and the honest reply promise, plus a help-article search box (Enter goes to `/help?q=`) and New ticket / Chat buttons. A small numbers strip shows open tickets, waiting for you, resolved in 30 days and the customer's own measured average first reply.
- **Four "ways to get help" cards,** each with its real current state: assistant online, ticket reply window, live service status, number of help articles. On phones they become a compact 2x2 grid. When a ticket thread is open the top section shrinks to one line so the conversation is visible straight away.
- **Ticket list:** rows instead of a table, so phones no longer hide status and priority behind sideways scrolling. Filter chips show counts, and search covers subject, message and #ref. Priority appears on a row only when it is High or Urgent.
- **Thread view:** a Ticket details side panel, easier-to-read bubbles, and chips showing the ticket's category and service. It scrolls to the newest message, and a single image attachment now shows at full width.
- **New ticket form:**
  - Steps: a category picker, a "Which service?" list of the customer's own servers, game servers, hosting and domains, and priority buttons with guidance.
  - Attachments, paste and dictation come from the existing reply box.
  - Help articles are suggested live while the customer types.
  - On phones it opens as a bottom sheet. It now renders at the top level of the page; before, the mobile bottom nav covered its Cancel / Open ticket buttons.
- **Backend:** `createTicket` takes the optional category and service with no schema change. They are written as a two-line `Category:` / `Service:` header on the first message; staff see it as plain text and the customer view turns it back into chips. The service is looked up again on the server, limited to the customer's own account.

**Checked end to end** on a throwaway database (now dropped), all as a customer — no admin or staff paths were run:
- A ticket with category, service and an image attachment was created, and the thread showed the chips and the image.
- Injecting another customer's server id was refused with an error, and no ticket was created.
- No emails, Discord posts or ticket replies were sent. The production database was not touched.

**Things I'm unsure about or deliberately left alone:**
1. The live-chat card says "Assistant online now" because the AI assistant really is always on. There is no data on whether a human agent is online, so that isn't claimed; if the livechat-overhaul branch adds staff presence, it could be wired in here.
2. On phones, inputs smaller than 16px trigger the iOS zoom-on-focus. That comes from the portal-wide `.input` style, so I didn't change it here.
3. The old `support-hero*.webp/png` files are still in `public/nx/art/` and nothing references them now. They can be deleted once you sign off.
4. Page styles live in a separate `app/dashboard/support/support.css` (only `nx-sup-*` classes) rather than `globals.css`, to avoid merge conflicts with the Domains and SSL branches. Those siblings also created `components/nx/visual/VectorArt.tsx` (SSL) and `DomainArt.tsx` (Domains). Each defines its own gradient helpers, so they could be merged into one shared file later.
5. The New ticket form only shows the service list when the page passes it in. The old modal had no other callers, so nothing else is affected.

Docs are appended to `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md` under "Customer Support page overhaul (2026-10-06)".
